verses.original: אֵל־ נְקָמ֥וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֖ל נְקָמ֣וֹת הוֹפִֽיַע׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl- nə·qā·mō·wṯ Yah·weh ’êl nə·qā·mō·wṯ hō·w·p̄i·ya‘
verses.literal: O LORD God of vengeance O God of vengeance shine forth
verses.literalPt: Ó SENHOR Deus, a quem a vingança pertence, ó Deus, a quem a vingança pertence, mostra-te resplandecente.

verses.original: הִ֭נָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵ֣ט הָאָ֑רֶץ הָשֵׁ֥ב גְּ֝מ֗וּל עַל־ גֵּאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nā·śê šō·p̄êṭ hā·’ā·reṣ hā·šêḇ gə·mūl ‘al- gê·’îm
verses.literal: Rise up O Judge of the earth render a reward to the proud
verses.literalPt: Exalta-te, tu, que és juiz da terra; dá a paga aos soberbos.

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֖י רְשָׁעִ֥ים׀ יְהוָ֑ה עַד־ מָ֝תַ֗י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay rə·šā·‘îm Yah·weh ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay rə·šā·‘îm ya·‘ă·lō·zū
verses.literal: How long . . . will the wicked O LORD how long . . . will the wicked exult
verses.literalPt: Até quando os ímpios, SENHOR, até quando os ímpios saltarão de prazer?

verses.original: יַבִּ֣יעוּ יְדַבְּר֣וּ עָתָ֑ק יִֽ֝תְאַמְּר֗וּ כָּל־ פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: yab·bî·‘ū yə·ḏab·bə·rū ‘ā·ṯāq yiṯ·’am·mə·rū kāl- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: They pour out arrogant words all workers of iniquity boast
verses.literalPt: Até quando proferirão, e falarão coisas duras, e se gloriarão todos os que praticam a iniqüidade?

verses.original: עַמְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה יְדַכְּא֑וּ וְֽנַחֲלָתְךָ֥ יְעַנּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mə·ḵā Yah·weh yə·ḏak·kə·’ū wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā yə·‘an·nū
verses.literal: They crush Your people O LORD they oppress Your heritage
verses.literalPt: Reduzem a pedaços o teu povo, ó SENHOR, e afligem a tua herança.

verses.original: אַ֭לְמָנָה וְגֵ֣ר יַהֲרֹ֑גוּ וִֽיתוֹמִ֣ים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·mā·nāh wə·ḡêr ya·hă·rō·ḡū wî·ṯō·w·mîm yə·raṣ·ṣê·ḥū
verses.literal: They kill the widow and the foreigner they murder the fatherless
verses.literalPt: Matam a viúva e o estrangeiro, e ao órfão tiram a vida.

verses.original: וַ֭יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־ יָּ֑הּ וְלֹא־ יָ֝בִ֗ין אֱלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lō yir·’eh- yāh wə·lō- yā·ḇîn ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: They say The LORD does not see the God of Jacob pays no heed
verses.literalPt: Contudo dizem: O SENHOR não o verá; nem para isso atenderá o Deus de Jacó.

verses.original: בִּ֭ינוּ בֹּעֲרִ֣ים בָּעָ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מָתַ֥י תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bî·nū bō·‘ă·rîm bā·‘ām ū·ḵə·sî·lîm mā·ṯay taś·kî·lū
verses.literal: Take notice O senseless among the people O fools when will you be wise
verses.literalPt: Atendei, ó brutais dentre o povo; e vós, loucos, quando sereis sábios?

verses.original: הֲנֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֭זֶן הֲלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם־ יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲלֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: hă·nō·ṭa‘ ’ō·zen hă·lō yiš·mā‘ ’im- yō·ṣêr ‘a·yin hă·lō yab·bîṭ
verses.literal: He who affixed the ear can He not hear He who formed the eye can He not see
verses.literalPt: Aquele que fez o ouvido não ouvirá? E o que formou o olho, não verá?

verses.original: הֲיֹסֵ֣ר גּ֭וֹיִם הֲלֹ֣א יוֹכִ֑יחַ הַֽמְלַמֵּ֖ד אָדָ֣ם דָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yō·sêr gō·w·yim hă·lō yō·w·ḵî·aḥ ham·lam·mêḏ ’ā·ḏām dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: He who admonishes the nations does He not discipline He who teaches man does He lack knowledge
verses.literalPt: Aquele que argüi os gentios não castigará? E o que ensina ao homem o conhecimento, não saberá?

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יֹ֭דֵעַ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָדָ֑ם כִּי־ הֵ֥מָּה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yō·ḏê·a‘ maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ’ā·ḏām kî- hêm·māh hā·ḇel
verses.literal: The LORD knows the thoughts of man that they are futile
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR conhece os pensamentos do homem, que são vaidade.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י׀ הַגֶּ֣בֶר אֲשֶׁר־ תְּיַסְּרֶ֣נּוּ יָּ֑הּ וּֽמִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ תְלַמְּדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê hag·ge·ḇer ’ă·šer- tə·yas·sə·ren·nū yāh ū·mit·tō·w·rā·ṯə·ḵā ṯə·lam·mə·ḏen·nū
verses.literal: Blessed is the man You discipline O LORD and teach from Your law
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurado é o homem a quem tu castigas, ó SENHOR, e a quem ensinas a tua lei;

verses.original: לְהַשְׁקִ֣יט ל֭וֹ מִ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עַ֤ד יִכָּרֶ֖ה לָרָשָׁ֣ע שָֽׁחַת׃
verses.transliteration: lə·haš·qîṭ lōw mî·mê rā‘ ‘aḏ yik·kā·reh lā·rā·šā‘ šā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: to grant him relief from days of trouble until a pit is dug for the wicked
verses.literalPt: Para lhe dares descanso dos dias maus, até que se abra a cova para o ímpio.

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ לֹא־ יִטֹּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְ֝נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א יַעֲזֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- yiṭ·ṭōš Yah·weh ‘am·mōw wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw lō ya·‘ă·zōḇ
verses.literal: For the LORD will not forsake His people He will never abandon His heritage
verses.literalPt: Pois o SENHOR não rejeitará o seu povo, nem desamparará a sua herança.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עַד־ צֶ֭דֶק יָשׁ֣וּב מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝אַחֲרָ֗יו כָּל־ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘aḏ- ṣe·ḏeq yā·šūḇ miš·pāṭ wə·’a·ḥă·rāw kāl- yiš·rê- lêḇ
verses.literal: Surely . . . judgment will again be righteous and all the upright in heart will follow it
verses.literalPt: Mas o juízo voltará à retidão, e segui-lo-ão todos os retos de coração.

verses.original: מִֽי־ יָק֣וּם לִ֭י עִם־ מְרֵעִ֑ים מִֽי־ יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝י עִם־ פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yā·qūm lî ‘im- mə·rê·‘îm mî- yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ lî ‘im- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Who will rise up for me against the wicked Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity
verses.literalPt: Quem será por mim contra os malfeitores? Quem se porá por mim contra os que praticam a iniqüidade?

verses.original: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י כִּמְעַ֓ט׀ שָֽׁכְנָ֖ה דוּמָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: lū·lê Yah·weh ‘ez·rā·ṯāh lî kim·‘aṭ šā·ḵə·nāh ḏū·māh nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Unless the LORD had been my helper I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence
verses.literalPt: Se o SENHOR não tivera ido em meu auxílio, a minha alma quase que teria ficado no silêncio.

verses.original: אִם־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי מָ֣טָה רַגְלִ֑י חַסְדְּךָ֥ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִסְעָדֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ā·mar·tî mā·ṭāh raḡ·lî ḥas·də·ḵā Yah·weh yis·‘ā·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: If I say My foot is slipping Your loving devotion O LORD supports me
verses.literalPt: Quando eu disse: O meu pé vacila; a tua benignidade, SENHOR, me susteve.

verses.original: בְּרֹ֣ב שַׂרְעַפַּ֣י בְּקִרְבִּ֑י תַּ֝נְחוּמֶ֗יךָ יְֽשַׁעַשְׁע֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rōḇ śar·‘ap·pay bə·qir·bî tan·ḥū·me·ḵā yə·ša·‘aš·‘ū nap̄·šî
verses.literal: When anxiety overwhelms me . . . Your consolation delights my soul
verses.literalPt: Na multidão dos meus pensamentos dentro de mim, as tuas consolações recrearam a minha alma.

verses.original: הַֽ֭יְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּ֣א הַוּ֑וֹת יֹצֵ֖ר עָמָ֣ל עֲלֵי־ חֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: hay·ḥā·ḇə·rə·ḵā kis·sê haw·wō·wṯ yō·ṣêr ‘ā·māl ‘ă·lê- ḥōq
verses.literal: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally one devising mischief by decree
verses.literalPt: Porventura o trono de iniqüidade te acompanha, o qual forja o mal por uma lei?

verses.original: יָ֭גוֹדּוּ עַל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְדָ֖ם נָקִ֣י יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḡō·w·dū ‘al- ne·p̄eš ṣad·dîq wə·ḏām nā·qî yar·šî·‘ū
verses.literal: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death
verses.literalPt: Eles se ajuntam contra a alma do justo, e condenam o sangue inocente.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֬י יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י לְמִשְׂגָּ֑ב וֵ֝אלֹהַ֗י לְצ֣וּר מַחְסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî Yah·weh lî lə·miś·gāḇ wê·lō·hay lə·ṣūr maḥ·sî
verses.literal: But the LORD has been my stronghold and my God is my rock of refuge
verses.literalPt: Mas o SENHOR é a minha defesa; e o meu Deus é a rocha do meu refúgio.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֨ם׀ אֶת־ אוֹנָ֗ם וּבְרָעָתָ֥ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑ם יַ֝צְמִיתֵ֗ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ ‘ă·lê·hem ’eṯ- ’ō·w·nām ū·ḇə·rā·‘ā·ṯām yaṣ·mî·ṯêm yaṣ·mî·ṯêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness The LORD our God will destroy them
verses.literalPt: E trará sobre eles a sua própria iniqüidade; e os destruirá na sua própria malícia; o SENHOR nosso Deus os destruirá.
